_comment: Keyed by alert_id. Packet metadata only, never full payload capture.

ALERT-1001.notes: Single request/response pair. Response size consistent with a 403 error page. No sustained outbound transfer, no encoded blob, no anomalous flag combinations.

ALERT-2001.notes: 2.4 MB returned to an external host over 41 seconds against a 3306 listener. Response volume is ~1400x the 30-day median for this asset. High-entropy payload consistent with base64-encoded bulk record export.

ALERT-3001.notes: Short exchange. Response size consistent with an application error page. No sustained egress observed on this flow.

ALERT-4001.notes: 1.9 MB returned to an external host. Volume far outside baseline for this asset.

ALERT-5001.notes: 28 short-lived connections to 3306 in 7 seconds, most reset. Pattern consistent with port/service enumeration. No meaningful data returned to the client on any flow.

ALERT-5002.notes: 1.7 MB returned to 192.0.2.66, the same source that enumerated this asset earlier. High-entropy bulk transfer.

ALERT-6001.notes: 3.1 MB returned to an external host over 52 seconds. Strong volumetric exfiltration signal.
